title: Common ordinary twist and successive scalar chain model
statement: Let l,S,E,F,G,iota,kappa,m and W_H be as in the integral twist setting [def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Let C be an integral constructible object [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], P a flat-term K-flat complex [lem-pc-kflat-resolution] and e:Q(P)~C. Write T for ordinary scalar extension, chi for the fixed ordinary-to-completed comparison [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], mu for the derived component of CompletedLineTensor.associatorData [lem-pur-completed-line-tensor-coherence], and alpha for the published integralTwistOrdinaryBeta [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar]. There exists a chain isomorphism a:T_GF T_FE(W_E P)~W_G(T_GE P) sending c tensor (b tensor (x tensor y)) to (c*kappa(b) tensor x) tensor theta_GE(y). Its derived computation, including T_GF T_FE(W_E(e.inv)), both universal scalar counits, the exact-twist factorization maps, and W_G(Q(completionChain) >> inverse resolving comparison >> B_GE(e.hom)), is exactly mu_W_E(C) >> alpha_GE,C >> W_G(chi_GE,C). All maps and factors are the specified ones, as written verbatim in the attached Lean signature. This is the ordinary right-path model normalization; it asserts neither the completed twist tower nor its unit laws nor any rationalized equality.

proof.text: The twist line is locally free of rank one and its inverse is its dual. The flat-model clause of ordinary signed-line comparison shows that W_E(P) remains K-flat with flat terms.

proof.text: Compose scalarAssociatorComplex on W_E(P) with the single E-to-G twist chain comparison. The scalar associator tensor formula followed by the single twist formula gives c tensor (b tensor (x tensor y)) mapped to (c*kappa(b) tensor x) tensor theta_GE(y). These are maps after sheafification, so local tensor generation proves the formula without any global-section generation assumption.

proof.text: Apply the ordinary associator counit equation to the good twisted P. Naturality transports W_E(e.inv) and the exact-twist factorization through mu. Substitute the single-extension twist counit equation. The inverse target factorization cancels. The ordinary-to-completed comparison representative equation identifies the remaining counit followed by Q(completionChain) and inverse resolving comparison with chi on Q(P). Naturality moves e.hom to C and cancels e.inv e.hom. The remaining composite is mu_W_E(C) >> alpha_GE,C >> W_G(chi_GE,C). Only derived comparison maps, not a chain inverse to completion, have been inverted.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_twist_common_scalar_model (m : ℤ) :
    (∀ (C : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory l E S)
      (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E S).FullSubcategory)
      (e : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj ≅ C.obj),
      ∃ a : (completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l F G κ S).obj
          ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E F ι S).obj
            (((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj)) ≅
        ((integralSheafTwist l G S m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E G (κ.comp ι) S).obj P.obj),
        (∀ (i : ℤ) (U : S.ProEtᵒᵖ)
          (b : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l F S).obj.obj U)
          (c : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l G S).obj.obj U)
          (x : (P.obj.X i).val.obj U) (y : (integralTwistLine l E S m).val.obj U),
          (a.hom.f i).val.app U
              (completedScalarTensorSection l F G κ S _ U c
                (completedScalarTensorSection l E F ι S _ U b
                  (SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul
                    (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E S) _ _ U x y))) =
            SheafOfModules.siteSheafTensorTmul
              (A := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l G S) _ _ U
              (completedScalarTensorSection l E G (κ.comp ι) S _ U
                (c * (completedCoefficientMap l F G κ S).hom.app U b) x)
              ((twistScalarMaps l E S G (κ.comp ι) m).val.app U y)) ∧
        (completedDerivedScalarExtension l F G κ S).map
            ((completedDerivedScalarExtension l E F ι S).map
              ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.map e.inv)) ≫
          (completedDerivedScalarExtension l F G κ S).map
            ((completedDerivedScalarExtension l E F ι S).map
              ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P.obj)) ≫
          (completedDerivedScalarExtension l F G κ S).map
            (completedScalarCounit l E F ι S
              (((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj)) ≫
          completedScalarCounit l F G κ S
            ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E F ι S).obj
              (((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P.obj)) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map a.hom ≫
          (integralSheafTwist l G S m).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
            ((completedOrdinaryScalarComplex l E G (κ.comp ι) S).obj P.obj) ≫
          (integralSheafTwist l G S m).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((DerivedCategory.Q.map
                ((completedScalarChainComparison l E G (κ.comp ι) S).app P.obj) ≫
              (integralScalarExtensionComparisonOfUniverses l E G (κ.comp ι) S).inv.app P) ≫
              (integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E G (κ.comp ι) S).map e.hom) =
        (CompletedLineTensor.associatorData l E S F ι G κ).derived.hom.app
            ((integralSheafTwist l E S m).mapDerivedCategory.obj C.obj) ≫
          (integralTwistOrdinaryBeta l E G (κ.comp ι) S m).hom.app C ≫
          (integralSheafTwist l G S m).mapDerivedCategory.map
            ((completedScalarComparison l E G (κ.comp ι) S).app C.obj))
